question: Ticket 150133a3ca74 says 'When RedTicketRefused (cast door refuses), run_proof raises an unticketed trouble and emits red_unticketed. It does not write a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).', but outline 9.4.2.3.1 reads "Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon)." (Outline 9.4.2.3.1 requires run_proof to 'write a validation record' but the ticket prevents this when a gate refuses, writing a trouble (diagnostic report) instead—a different record type with different structure.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: Both stand; the question misreads the ticket. run_proof writes the validation record first (persist_validation, cairn/devices/tester/device.py:992) and only then tickets the red (ticket_what_is_new, :1007). A door refusal happens after the record is on disk, so it changes nothing about the record 9.4.2.3.1 requires; the trouble is added beside it, never in its place. The ticket now says so as a constraint.
